prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing in ensures your pet status and memory are saved permanently to your cloud account.", "Account Protection Active"]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Your new pet companion is registered and bound to your desktop session.", "Claim Companion", "Cloud Synced & Saved"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "We are getting your companion ready. Learn how to interact with them on your desktop while you wait.", "Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open control settings or hide it."]
3: ["Choose How to Meet Your Companion", "Pick a ready-to-go preset pet or create a unique desktop companion from your own photos.", "Continue", "Select Path"]
4: []
5: ["For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with good lighting.", "Clear face lighting, Single subject, High resolution image"]
6: ["Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!", "Here is how to interact with your new companion anytime:", "Start Playing", "Right-click to open controls, Drag to move on screen, Double-click to talk"]
7: ["Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you the moment your pet appears on your desktop.", "Background Rendering Active"]
8: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion in Seconds", "Adopt a digital pet that lives right on your screen, responds to your work, and keeps you company.", "Get Started"]
9: ["Onboarding Complete! Starter Gift Unlocked", "You have unlocked the Welcome Companion Pack for your desktop pet.", "Unlocked: Desktop Toy & Treat Pack"]
